notes.content: Thank you for your interest in Sacramento State! This articulation agreement displays the lower-division courses required in the major: Sacramento State courses on the left and approved (articulated) transfer courses on the right. Although completion of the coursework listed below is not mandatory prior to admission, students are advised to complete as much lower-division course preparation as possible prior to transfer. Additional Resources: See the University Catalog for the full listing of degree requirements for this major. Visit our Sac State Apply page for more information about our campus! notes.content: A GPA of 2.75 is required in courses applied to the major. There are no specific lower-division course requirements for the major. However, students must demonstrate competency through the second semester of intermediate level French (French 2B) prior to transfer and before completing upper-division coursework. For additional information, please visit: Department of World Languages & Literatures .
